experiment: Share immutable cold metric series labels from Index through MetricBlockStore and the existing merged instant-scan caller.
retention_decision: Pending other signal controls and final retained-source qualification. Mimir CPU is lower in each pair (median ratio 0.991), but ranges overlap. Aggregate RSS median is 2.6% lower, with one pair worse; query p99 is worse in two pairs. No consistent latency gain claimed. Exact baseline contains the subsequently rejected Loki owned-index change.

validation.negative_control: Removing only MetricBlockStore shared-series forwarding fails both production ownership regressions; other 630 PromQL and metrics-service unit cases pass. Actual source restored before qualification.
validation.wire_golden: Fixed JSON and binary v2 shard ledger passes on both original index and candidate.

scope: No measured performance gain claimed. Local correctness checks are distinct from pending private-GCP performance qualification.

reverted_loki_followup.scope: Measure cold-series sharing after removing the rejected Loki owned-index change. Isolate against ca99 without that Loki change; preserve the new source image as the prospective owned-WAL baseline. This is not final all-four-signal qualification.
